canon-eos-r10: Light, with a good grip and real controls; no IBIS or sealing.
canon-eos-r100: Great-value first or travel camera; autofocus struggles with birds.
canon-eos-r5-mark-ii: Pre-capture and resolution for wildlife; video heat is a gripe.
canon-eos-r50: Small, light first camera; some mode dials and shutters failed.
canon-eos-r50-v: Small video-first body that shoots good stills; no viewfinder.
canon-eos-r6-mark-ii: Sticky autofocus and good battery; colours look dull to some.
canon-eos-r6-mark-iii: Pre-capture and room to crop; high-ISO noise slightly worse.
canon-eos-r7: Crop reach and a comfy grip for wildlife; autofocus is inconsistent.
canon-eos-r8: Full frame in a very light body; the grip rubber peels for some.
canon-powershot-v1: Pocket video camera with a wide 16mm and ND; short battery life.
dji-osmo-pocket-3: Pocketable with smooth stabilisation; delicate, not water resistant.
fujifilm-gfx100rf: Medium format in a compact body; f/4 and no IBIS limit low light.
fujifilm-x-e5: Small, premium-feeling body; weak battery and a touchy eye sensor.
fujifilm-x-half: Tiny, fun and film-like; overpriced for its image quality.
fujifilm-x-m5: Tiny and light for every day; no viewfinder hurts in bright sun.
fujifilm-x-s20: Deep grip and long battery; overheating in video is the top gripe.
fujifilm-x-t5: Tactile dials and light; autofocus trails rivals on moving subjects.
fujifilm-x100vi: Lovely colours to carry everywhere; slow autofocus in low light.
gopro-mission-1: Cleaner low light and range; a couple find it heavy to grade.
insta360-luna-ultra: Strong low light and a detachable screen; overheats in long 4K.
insta360-x5: Strong low-light 360 video; bulky, with slow editing.
leica-d-lux-8: Pocketable, sharp zoom and good viewfinder; pricey for its sensor.
leica-q3: Sharp lens and simple menus for travel; autofocus lags on kids.
leica-q3-43: Exceptionally sharp and simple; autofocus feels slow to converts.
leica-q3-monochrom: Clean high-ISO files and rich black and white in low light.
nikon-z30: Small, light travel and vlogging camera; no viewfinder.
nikon-z50ii: Subject autofocus handles birds for the price; no stabilisation.
nikon-z5ii: Great value with fast autofocus; a few missed focus on pets.
nikon-z8: Blackout-free viewfinder and great tracking; big and heavy.
nikon-zf: Retro dials and fun to shoot; the shallow grip strains big lenses.
ricoh-gr-iiix: Truly pocketable with sharp images; the autofocus is weak.
ricoh-gr-iv: Pocketable with a great lens; the fixed 28mm takes adjusting to.
sony-a6700: Superb tracking in a compact body; overheats in long 4K video.
sony-a7-v: AI autofocus and pre-capture for action; little image gain for some.
sony-a7c-ii: Tiny full frame with near-automatic focus; front-heavy with big glass.
sony-rx100-vii: Long zoom and viewfinder in a pocket; fragile or slow for a few.
